title: Inside the results: How redistricting shaped Tennessee’s primary election
english: Tennessee recently held its first primary election using a new congressional map that was redrawn to potentially favor Republican candidates. This redistricting process notably split a majority-Black district in Memphis, impacting the political landscape for the upcoming midterm elections. As Republicans aim to maintain their slim control of the US House, these primary results finalized the candidates who will compete for leadership roles in November.
amharic: ቴነሲ በቅርቡ በአዲስ የምርጫ ክልል ካርታ የመጀመሪያውን የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ አካሂዳለች፤ ይህ ካርታ ለሪፐብሊካን እጩዎች ጠቀሜታ ሊሰጥ በሚችል መልኩ የተቀረጸ ነው። ይህ የድንበር ማስተካከያ በሜምፊስ የሚገኘውን አብዛኛውን ጥቁር ህዝብ ያቀፈ የምርጫ ክልል በመከፋፈሉ፣ በመጪው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል። ሪፐብሊካኖች በአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ያላቸውን ጠባብ የበላይነት ለማስጠበቅ በሚጥሩበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የምርጫ ውጤቶቹ በኖቬምበር ወር የሚደረገውን የመጨረሻ ፉክክር እጩዎች ለይተዋል።
oromo: Teennesiin dhiheenya kana filannoo sadarkaa duraa kan godhatte kaartaa daangaa filannoo haaraa itti fayyadamuun yoo ta'u, kaartiin kunis garee Rippabilikaanootaaf faayidaa akka argamsiisuuf kan qophaaye dha. Daangaa kana jijjiirun kun godina Meemfisi keessatti kan argamuifi guddina ummata gurraacha qabu bakka lamatti hiruu isaa hordofee, filannoo gara fuulduraa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'a. Rippabilikaanonnii to'annoo Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa irratti qaban cimsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran keessatti, bu'aaleen kun namoota ji'a Sadaasaa keessa wal dorgoman ifa godhaniiru.

title: Yemen’s Houthis claim attack on Marib hit Saudi-backed forces
english: Houthi rebels in Yemen have announced a military strike against forces supported by Saudi Arabia near the city of Marib. The group claims to have destroyed military gear and supply centers during the operation. Furthermore, the Houthis have warned that they will persist in targeting Saudi-backed troops to challenge the ongoing blockade of their territory.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ አማፂያን በማሪብ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሚደገፉ ኃይሎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ በዚሁ ጥቃት ወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎችን እና የጦር መጋዘኖችን ማውደሙን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም የየመንን ድንበር ዘግተው የያዙ ኃይሎችን መታገላቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Houtii kan Yemen, loltoota Sa’udii Arabiyaan deggeraman kan magaala Marib bira jiran irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Gareen kun haleellaa kanaan meeshaalee waraanaa fi kuusaa waraanaa barbadeessuu isaa ibseera. Akkasumas, Houtiin biyyattii irratti duula gaggeeffamaa jiru mormuuf jecha, humni Sa’udii fi tumsa isaa irratti haleellaa itti fufsiisuu akka barbaadan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Lebanon, Israel agree shortlist of countries that could send troops to verify Hezbollah disarmament
english: Lebanon and Israel have established a list of potential countries that could monitor the disarmament of Hezbollah as part of a US-brokered agreement. The United States will make the final selection from this list, which excludes nations rejected by either side. Although this deal aims to facilitate an Israeli troop withdrawal, Hezbollah remains opposed to disarming.
amharic: ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት ሂዝቦላህ ትጥቅ መፍታቱን የሚቆጣጠሩ ሀገራትን ዝርዝር አዘጋጅተዋል። አሜሪካ ከሁለቱም ወገኖች ተቀባይነት ካላቸው ሀገራት መካከል የመጨረሻውን ምርጫ ታደርጋለች። ይህ ስምምነት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከሊባኖስ እንዲወጡ ለማድረግ የታቀደ ቢሆንም፣ ሂዝቦላህ ግን ትጥቅ ለመፍታት ፈቃደኛ አይደለም።
oromo: Libanoos fi Israa'el gargaarsa Ameerikaatiin gareen 'Hezbollah' hidhannoo hiikuu isaa kan hordofan biyyoota filatan irratti walii galaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyoota kanneen keessaa filannoo dhumaa kan gootu yoo ta'u, biyyoonni garee lamaanuu irraa mormii qaban tarree kana keessa hin jiran. Walii galteen kun waraanni Israa'el Libanoos keessaa akka ba'u kan tumu ta'us, Hezbollah garuu hidhannoo hiikuuf fedhii hin qabu.

title: Israeli forces beat and detain Palestinian during settler attack near Nablus
english: Israeli troops and settlers carried out a raid in the West Bank town of Beit Furik, resulting in the assault and arrest of a Palestinian man in his forties. Medical workers reported that military forces blocked their ambulance from providing assistance to the victim. Additionally, settlers caused damage to local homes and security equipment during the violent unrest in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው በቤት ፉሪክ ከተማ ባደረጉት ጥቃት በአርባዎቹ ዕድሜ ውስጥ የሚገኝ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ተደብድቦ ታስሯል። የህክምና ቡድኖች እንደገለጹት ወታደሮቹ የአምቡላንስ ተሽከርካሪ በጉዳት ላይ ወደነበረው ሰው እንዳይደርስ አግደዋል። በዚሁ ወቅት ሰፋሪዎች በአካባቢው ያሉ ቤቶችን እና የክትትል ካሜራዎችን በማውደም በነዋሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni biyya lafaa magaalaa Beit Furik keessatti raawwatanin, dhiirri umriin isaa waggaa afurtamoota keessatti argamu tokko reebamee hidhameera. Hojjettoonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el ambulaansii miidhamaa sana gargaaruuf deemutti gufuu ta'aniiru. Kana malees, qubattoonni kun manneen jireenyaa fi kaameraa to'annoo naannichaa mancaasuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Exclusive: ICC judges order Taliban case split from Afghanistan probe that covers US troops
english: The International Criminal Court has decided to separate investigations into gender-based persecution by the Taliban from the wider probe into war crimes in Afghanistan. This change means the Taliban-specific allegations will be handled independently from inquiries involving U.S. military and CIA personnel. Critics worry this move might be an attempt to improve relations with Washington by distancing the court from investigations into American citizens.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በታሊባን ላይ የሚቀርቡ የሥርዓተ-ፆታ ጭቆና ክሶችን ከአፍጋኒስታን ሰፊው የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ለይቶ እንዲመለከት ወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ የታሊባን ጉዳዮች ከአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እና ከሲአይኤ ጋር ከተያያዙ ጉዳዮች ተለይተው እንዲታዩ ያደርጋል። ይህ እርምጃ ፍርድ ቤቱ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማለዘብ ሲል ከአሜሪካውያን ጋር የተያያዙ ምርመራዎችን ለመተው መዘጋጀቱን የሚያሳይ እንደሆነ እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa, himannaa ari’annaa saalaan walqabatee garee Taaliban irratti dhiyaatu, qorannoo waraana Afgaanistaan waliigalaa irraa gargar baasee akka ilaalu murteesseera. Jijjiiramni kun himannaan Taaliban irratti qabu, qorannoo waraana Ameerikaa fi hojjettoota CIA irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru irraa adda ta’ee akka ilaalamu taasisa. Tarkaanfiin kun, mana murtichaa qorannoo lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti gaggeeffamu dhaabuun waldhabdee Waashingitan waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf yaalii akka ta’e yaadama.

title: Anti-Muslim lawmaker Andy Ogles loses Republican primary
english: Tennessee Congressman Andy Ogles, known for his harsh anti-Muslim rhetoric, was defeated in the Republican primary by farmer Charlie Hatcher. Despite receiving an endorsement from Donald Trump, Ogles lost to Hatcher, who benefited from significant outside funding and a focus on agricultural issues. The election outcome followed recent district boundary changes and growing public criticism of Ogles' inflammatory statements regarding Muslim Americans.
amharic: በእስልምና እምነት ተከታዮች ላይ በሚያደርሱት አጸያፊ ንግግሮች የሚታወቁት የቴነሲው የኮንግረስ አባል አንዲ ኦግልስ፣ በሪፐብሊካን የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ ተሸንፈዋል። ምንም እንኳን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ኦግልስ በገበሬው ቻርሊ ሃቸር ተሸንፈዋል። የሃቸር ድል በምርጫ ክልል ድንበር ላይ በተደረጉ ለውጦች እና ኦግልስ በሙስሊሞች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ አክራሪ ንግግሮች ባስከተሉት ተቃውሞ የተነሳ እንደሆነ ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii Teenesii kan ta'an Andy Ogles, ibsawwan Islaamummaa irratti xiyyeeffatan qaban irraa kan ka'e, filannoo duraa paartii Rippaabilikaanii keessatti injifatamaniiru. Deggersa Donald Traamp qabaachuu isaanii irra iyyuu, Ogles qonnaan bulaa Charlie Hatcher irratti injifatamuun isaanii dinqisiisaa ta'eera. Injifannoon Hatcher jijjiirama daangaa ganda filannoo fi ibsawwan jibbinsaa Ogles gareewwan amantii Islaamaa irratti dabarsaa turanirratti mormiin uumamuun kan dhufedha.

title: New Delhi on red alert as heavy rains pound the city
english: Severe rainfall has hit New Delhi and surrounding areas, leading to significant transportation delays and stranded residents in flood-prone zones. Authorities have officially declared a red alert for the city due to the extreme weather conditions. Meteorologists expect the heavy downpours to continue until the situation gradually improves by Sunday.
amharic: በኒው ዴልሂ እና በአካባቢዋ ባጋጠመው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የመንገድ ትራንስፖርት ተስተጓጉሎ ነዋሪዎች ችግር ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። የሕንድ የአየር ንብረት ቢሮ በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደሚኖር የሚያሳይ የቀይ ማስጠንቀቂያ አውጇል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ እስከ እሁድ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል እና ከዚያ በኋላ እንደሚሻሻል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa Niiw Deelhiifi naannawwii ishee mudatee jiru, geejjiba guutuutti dhaabuun namoota bakka gad-aanaa jiraatan miidhee jira. Biiroon qilleensa-galchii Indiyaa balaa roobichaan walqabatee akeekkachiisa cimaa (red alert) labseera. Haalli kun hanga Dilbatti kan itti fufuufi booda immoo kan tasgabbaa'u ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Mediterranean smuggling network ‘dismantled’ in Spain-led raid, 78 arrested
english: Spanish authorities and international partners have successfully dismantled a major criminal organization responsible for smuggling thousands of migrants, drugs, and weapons across the Mediterranean. The operation led to 78 arrests and the seizure of 18 high-speed boats used to transport people in dangerous, inhumane conditions. This criminal network generated over 24 million euros by operating sophisticated routes between Algeria and Spain.
amharic: የስፔን ባለስልጣናት ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮቻቸው ጋር በመተባበር በሜዲትራኒያን ባህር በኩል በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ስደተኞችን፣ አደንዛዥ እጾችን እና መሳሪያዎችን ሲያዘዋውር የነበረ ትልቅ የወንጀል ቡድንን መበተን ችለዋል። በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን 78 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን ለስደተኞች ማጓጓዣነት ያገለግሉ የነበሩ 18 ፈጣን ጀልባዎችም ተይዘዋል። ይህ ቡድን ከአልጄሪያ ወደ ስፔን በሚያደርገው ህገ-ወጥ እንቅስቃሴ ከ24 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በላይ ማትረፉንና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለአደጋ ማጋለጡን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ispeen qindeessummaa dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa waliin ta'uun, garee yakkaatiifi nama baqachiisuu, darbuu darawaa fi meeshaa waraanaa daangaa galaana Mediteraniyaa irra deddeebii raawwataa ture tokko diiguu danda'aniiru. Tarkaanfii kana keessatti namoonni 78 to'annoo jala oolaniiru akkasumas dooniiwwan namoota dawoo hin qabne keessatti fe'uun balaa keessa buusaa turan 18 ta'an qabamaniiru. Gareen yakkaa kun karaa biyyoota Aljeeriyaafi Ispeen gidduu jiru fayyadamuun qarshii Yuuroo miliyoona 24 ol argachaa kan ture yoo ta'u, namoota kumaatamaan lakka'amanis balaa guddaa keessa buusa turan.

title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
english: Spanish and Algerian authorities have dismantled a major criminal syndicate involved in trafficking drugs, weapons, and migrants across the Mediterranean. The group used high-speed, unregistered boats to move illicit goods and people, charging migrants large sums for dangerous sea crossings. During the extensive operation, police arrested 78 suspects and seized significant assets, including millions of euros worth of vessels and various illegal narcotics.
amharic: የስፔን እና የአልጄሪያ ባለስልጣናት በመካከለኛው ባህር ላይ አደንዛዥ እጾችን፣ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን እና ስደተኞችን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ሲያዘዋውር የነበረ ትልቅ የወንጀል ቡድን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ቡድኑ በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ የተመዘገቡ ፈጣን ጀልባዎችን በመጠቀም ሰዎችን እና እቃዎችን በድብቅ ያዘዋውር የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞችንም ለከፍተኛ ገንዘብ አጋልጠው ነበር። በተካሄደው የተቀናጀ ኦፕሬሽን 78 ተጠርጣሪዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዩሮ የሚገመቱ ጀልባዎች እና የተለያዩ ህገ-ወጥ እቃዎች ተይዘዋል።
oromo: Mootummoonni Ispeenii fi Aljeeriyaa garee yakkaa guddaa qoricha sammua namaa hadoochu, meeshaa waraanaa fi godaantota garba karaa Meditiraaneenii ceesisaa ture to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Gareen kun dooniiwwan ariitii olaanaa qabanii fi seeraan ala ta'an fayyadamuun namaa fi meeshaa seeraan ala akka ce'an gochuun, godaantota irraas maallaqa guddaa fudhachaa turaniiru. Hojii qindaa'aa kanaan shakkamtoonni 78 to'atamanii, dooniiwwan gatiin isaanii miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu fi meeshaaleen seeraan alaa garaa garaa qabamaniiru.

title: Hun Manet is refining Cambodia’s authoritarian model
english: Despite early hopes that Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet would introduce democratic reforms, he has instead continued his father's authoritarian legacy. Rather than relying on overt violence, his administration now utilizes sophisticated legal tactics, digital surveillance, and elite patronage to maintain power. This modern approach has effectively suppressed dissent while making the government's control over society appear more subtle and organized.
amharic: የካምቦዲያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሁን ማኔት ዲሞክራሲያዊ ለውጥ ያመጣሉ ተብሎ ቢጠበቅም፣ በአባታቸው የተጀመረውን አምባገነናዊ አገዛዝ ማስቀጠላቸው ታይቷል። አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር ጥቂት ግልጽ የሆኑ የኃይል እርምጃዎችን በመጠቀም ፈንታ፣ የበለጠ ውስብስብ የሆኑ የሕግ ማዕቀፎችን፣ የዲጂታል ክትትልን እና የጥቅም ትስስሮችን በመጠቀም ስልጣኑን ለማጠናከር እየሰራ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ የመንግስትን ቁጥጥር ይበልጥ የተራቀቀና ተቃዋሚዎችን ለማፈን ውጤታማ እንዲሆን አድርጎታል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Kamboodiyaa Hun Maaneet jijjiirama dimokiraasii fidu jedhamee eegamuus, sirna abbaa irree kan abbaa isaa itti fufeera. Bulchiinsi isaa humnaa fi tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu irra, seera fayyadamuu, hordoffii dijitaalaa fi hariiroo maallaqaa fayyadamuun aangoo isaa jabeeffachaa jira. Akkaataan kunis giddu seenummaa fi too'annoo mootummaa kan duraa caalaa kan dhokataa fi itti fufiinsa qabu taasiseera.

title: War on Iran: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan sign defence pact
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have established a new three-way defense agreement in Mecca to improve their collective security. The pact declares that an act of military aggression against any one of the member nations will be considered an attack on all three. This strategic alliance aims to strengthen their regional defense capabilities and discourage potential threats.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በሜካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ በአንዱ አባል ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ማንኛውም ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ እንደሚቆጠር ይደነግጋል። ይህ ትብብር የጋራ ደህንነትን ለማጠናከር እና ሊያጋጥሙ የሚችሉ የውጭ ስጋቶችን ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiin fi Paakistaan magaalaa Makkaatti waliigaltee ittisaa sadii gidduutti taasifamu mallatteessaniiru. Waliigalteen kun biyyoota sadan kana keessaa kamiyyuu irratti yoo haleellaan waraanaa raawwatame, kanneen hafan hundi akka irratti haleellaa raawwatametti akka fudhatan ibsa. Walta'iinsi kun nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf fi sodaa waraanaa ittisuuf kan gumaachuudha.

title: US labour market sheds jobs in July as labour force participation slumps
english: The U.S. labor market saw a loss of 23,000 jobs in July, primarily driven by significant downturns in the government, education, and retail sectors. Although the unemployment rate dropped to 4.1 percent, this is largely due to a sharp decline in labor force participation, which has reached its lowest point in five years. Overall, hundreds of thousands of people have stopped working or searching for employment, contributing to a sluggish hiring environment.
amharic: በሐምሌ ወር የአሜሪካ የሥራ ገበያ 23,000 የሥራ ዕድሎችን አጥቷል፤ ይህም በዋነኝነት በመንግሥት፣ በትምህርት እና በችርቻሮ ንግድ ዘርፎች በተከሰተ መቀነስ የተነሳ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የሥራ አጥነት ምጣኔው ወደ 4.1 በመቶ ዝቅ ቢልም፣ ይህ የሆነው በዋናነት በሥራ ኃይል ተሳትፎ መቀነስ ምክንያት ሲሆን ይህም በአምስት ዓመታት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። በአጠቃላይ፣ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ከሥራ ገበያው በመውጣታቸው የቅጥር እንቅስቃሴው አዝጋሚ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gabaan hojii Ameerikaa ji'a Adoolessaa keessa hojii 23,000 kan dhabe yoo ta'u, kunis damee mootummaa, barnootaa fi daldalaa keessatti hir'ina mudateen kan wal qabatuudha. Gatiin hoji-dhabdummaa gara dhibbeentaa 4.1 tti kan gadi bu'e yoo ta'u, kunis guddinaan kan dhufu hirmaannaan hojjettootaa gadi bu'uu isaatiin yoo ta'u, kunis waggaa shanan darban keessatti sadarkaa gadaanaa irra jira. Walumaagalatti, namoonni dhibbootaan lakkaa'aman gabaa hojii keessaa waan bahanif, haalli hojii qabachuu guddinaan kan hir'ate ta'uu isaa gabaasni kun ni agarsiisa.

title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkiye defence pact challenges US role
english: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye have signed a new defense agreement that signifies a major shift in regional security dynamics. This partnership suggests that these nations are losing confidence in the United States as a dependable security partner. By forming this alliance, Saudi Arabia aims to improve its ability to deter potential threats independently.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ቱርክ በአዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ላይ ተፈራርመዋል፤ ይህም በክልሉ የጸጥታ መዋቅር ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥን ያመጣል። ይህ ስምምነት አገራቱ በአሜሪካ ላይ የነበራቸው እምነት እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። በዚህ ህብረት አማካኝነት ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የራሷን የጸጥታ አቅም ለማጠናከር እና ስጋቶችን ለመከላከል ትጥራለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Paakistaanii fi Turkii walii galtee ittisa biyyaa haaraa kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis nageenya naannichaa keessatti jijjiirama guddaa argisiisa. Walta'iinsi kun biyyoonni kun kutannoo isaan Ameerikaa irraa qaban hir'achaa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha. Walta'iinsa kanaan, Saudii Arabiyaan dandeettii ofiitiin sodaa gara fuulduraa ofirraa ittisuuf karoorfattee jirti.

title: Italy vows to maintain border checks despite Spain’s countermeasures threat
english: The Italian government has refused to end temporary border controls despite a threat of retaliation from Spain. Italy claims these measures are necessary for national security following a major migrant crisis in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. Spain, however, views these restrictions as unfair and has warned that it will take proportional action if they are not removed by the deadline.
amharic: የጣሊያን መንግስት ከስፔን የደረሰውን የማጥቂያ እርምጃ ማስፈራሪያ ችላ በማለት በድንበር ላይ የጀመረውን ጊዜያዊ የቁጥጥር ስራ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ጣሊያን ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደችው በስፔን ግዛት በሆነችው ሴውታ በተከሰተው የስደተኞች ቀውስ ምክንያት ለሀገር ደህንነት አስፈላጊ ነው በሚል ነው። ስፔን በበኩሏ እነዚህ ገደቦች ተገቢ አይደሉም በማለት ቁጥጥሩ ካልተነሳ ተመጣጣኝ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii gorsaa fi doorsisaa biyya Ispeen irraa dhufe diduun, daangaa irratti to’annoo yeroo qaban itti fufuuf murteesseera. Xaaliyaaniin tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, naannoo Ispeen kan taate Ceuta keessatti rakkoo godaantotaa mudateen booda nageenya biyyaa eeggachuuf jecha akka ta’e ibsiteetti. Ispeen garuu to’annoon kun sirrii miti jechuun, yoo yerichi darbe tarkaanfii wal-gitu fudhachuuf akka dirqamtu akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Spain threatens retaliation if Italy fails to lift border controls after Ceuta crossings
english: Spain has warned Italy of potential retaliation if it does not remove the border restrictions imposed following a mass influx of migrants into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. Italy claims these controls are necessary to prevent further migration, but Spain insists the measures are unfair and lack a factual basis since most migrants have already returned to Morocco. Tensions remain high as Italy has rejected Spain's demand, stating it will maintain the restrictions until mid-August.
amharic: ስፔን ወደ ሴኡታ ግዛት በገቡ በርካታ ስደተኞች ምክንያት ጣሊያን በድንበሯ ላይ የጣለችውን ገደብ ካላነሳች በቀል እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቃለች። ጣሊያን ይህን የወሰደችው ተጨማሪ ስደተኞችን ለመከላከል እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ ስፔን አብዛኞቹ ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ የተመለሱ በመሆናቸው እርምጃው ተገቢ አይደለም በማለት ትቃወማለች። ጣሊያን የስፔንን ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ እስከ ነሐሴ አጋማሽ ድረስ ገደቡን እንደምትቀጥል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ispeeniin godina Se'uutaa keessatti godaantotni hedduun erga galanii booda, Xaaliyaaniin daangaa ishee irratti dhorkaa kaa'e yoo hin kaasin tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti. Xaaliyaaniin dhorkaan kun godaansa dabalataa ittisuuf barbaachisaa dha yoo jettu, Ispeeniin garuu godaantotni hedduun gara Morookootti waan deebi'aniif tarkaanfichi haqa kan hin qabneefi bu'uura kan hin qabne dha jetteetti. Xaaliyaaniin gaaffii Ispeenii diduudhaan hanga dhuma torbee darbee giddutti dhorkaa kana akka itti fuftu ibsiteetti.

title: Mexico and Peru restore diplomatic relations after asylum row
english: Mexico and Peru have officially restored diplomatic relations following a period of tension caused by the granting of asylum to a former Peruvian prime minister. Betssy Chávez, who was involved in a 2022 coup attempt, has been allowed to travel to Mexico despite facing legal charges in her home country. The two nations decided to reconcile based on their historic ties, though Peru reserves the right to seek her extradition in the future.
amharic: ሜክሲኮ እና ፔሩ የቀድሞዋን የፔሩ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጥገኝነት በመስጠታቸው ተፈጥሮ የነበረውን የዲፕሎማሲ ቀውስ በመፍታት ግንኙነታቸውን እንደገና ጀምረዋል። በ2022 የመንግስት ግልበጣ ሙከራ ውስጥ ተሳትፈዋል የተባሉት ቤቲ ቻቬዝ ወደ ሜክሲኮ እንዲሄዱ ቢፈቀድላቸውም፣ ፔሩ በወደፊት ጊዜ ተከሳሿን ለፍርድ የማቅረብ መብቷ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ሁለቱ አገራት ታሪካዊ ወዳጅነታቸውን መሠረት በማድረግ ለግጭቱ መፍትሄ መስጠት ችለዋል።
oromo: Meksiikoo fi Peeruun ministira muummee Peeru durii tokkoof bakka buufata godoo (asylum) kennuurraa kan ka’e rakkoo dippiloomaasii uumame booda, walitti dhufeenya isaanii haaromsuuf walii galaniiru. Beetisii Chaavez kan jedhaman, yaalii fonqolcha mootummaa bara 2022 irratti hirmaataniiru jedhamanii kanneen himataman yoo ta'u, biyyi isaanii Peeruun gara fuulduraatti isaan dabarsitee kennitootaaf gaafachuuf mirga akka qabdu ibsiteetti. Biyyonni lamaanuu hariiroo seena qabeessa isaanii kabajuuf jechuun rakkoo isaanii mariin furuuf murteessaniiru.

title: Seven killed after teen shooter opens fire at home and school in Thailand
english: A 14-year-old student in Thailand killed his grandparents and five teachers before dying by suicide. The attack, which left 23 people injured, has sparked urgent calls for the government to implement stricter gun control measures. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, noting that the shooter appeared to have planned the violence carefully.
amharic: ታይላንድ ውስጥ የ14 ዓመት ተማሪ በቤቱ እና በትምህርት ቤቱ የፈፀመው የተኩስ ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። በጥቃቱ 23 ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት መንግስት ጥብቅ የሆነ የጦር መሳሪያ ቁጥጥር እንዲያደርግ ከፍተኛ ግፊት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ጥቃቱ በጥንቃቄ የታቀደ እንደነበር በመግለጽ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: biyya Taayilaanditti barataan umriin isaa waggaa 14 ta'e tokko mana isaa fi mana barnootaatti dhukaasa banuudhaan namoota torba ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun namoota 23 irratti kan ga'e yoo ta'u, gochi kun mootummaan seera qawwee irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu dhiibbaa uumee jira. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, barataan kun miidhaa kana duraan karoofatee kan raawwate akka ta'e fi ammas qorannoon itti fufee akka jiru beekameera.

title: Sri Lanka prisoners riot leaving 3 dead, 23 injured in chaos
english: Violent riots broke out across several Sri Lankan prisons, resulting in three inmate deaths and twenty-three injuries. Authorities successfully contained the unrest with police and special forces, and they are currently investigating potential coordination between criminal gangs and drug dealers. These disturbances highlight the ongoing crisis of severe overcrowding within the country's prison system.
amharic: በስሪ ላንካ በተለያዩ እስር ቤቶች በተቀሰቀሰ ረብሻ ሶስት እስረኞች ሲሞቱ ሃያ ሶስት የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የፀጥታ ሃይሎች ረብሻውን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉት ሲሆን፣ የዘረፋ እና የአደንዛዥ እፅ ቡድኖች በጉዳዩ ላይ እጅ እንዳለባቸው በመጠረጠር ምርመራ እየተደረገ ነው። ይህ ሁከት በሀገሪቱ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ከፍተኛ የሰው መጨናነቅ ችግር አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Sri Laankaa keessatti giddugaleessa hidhaa gara garaa keessatti fincilli ka'een hidhamtoonni saddeet du'anii, digdamii sadii immoo madaa'aniiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa fincila kana to'annaa jala kan oolchan yoo ta'u, walitti bu'iinsa kana duuba gareewwan yakkaafi gurgurtoonni qoricha sammuu hadoochu akka jiran shakkamee qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira. Fincilli kun rakkoo cinaa'insa hidhamtootaa biyyattii keessatti bal'inaan mul'atu ibsa.

title: Two civilians killed in Houthi strike on Marib, says Yemen’s government
english: The Yemeni government reports that a Houthi strike on the city of Marib has resulted in the deaths of two civilians and left 14 others injured. Officials condemned the attack for deliberately targeting residential areas and camps housing displaced families. This incident follows a recent surge in regional violence and military clashes involving Houthi forces across Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት በማሪብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሁለት ንፁሀን ዜጎች መገደላቸውን እና 14 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። መንግስት ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን እና ተፈናቃዮች የሚገኙባቸውን ካምፖች ሆን ተብሎ ያነጣጠረ ነው ሲል አውግዟል። ይህ ድርጊት በየመን እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ ድንበር አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት ተከትሎ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, haleellaa gareen Huthis magaalaa Maariib irratti raawwateen namoonni nagaa lama du'anii 14 madaa'aniiru. Mootummaan haleellaan kun iddoolee jireenyaa fi bakka buqqaattonni qubataniitti xiyyeeffachuusaanii balaaleffateera. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa Yemen fi Sa'udii Arabiyaa keessatti hammaachaa jiru wajjin walqabatee kan dhufe dha.

title: Imade
english: Imade, a 23-year-old deaf migrant from Morocco, has spent the last six years building an independent life in Spain while working as a kitchen porter. After leaving his home at age 16 to reduce the financial burden on his family, he is now preparing for a meaningful visit back to Morocco. This trip marks his first family reunion since he originally moved abroad.
amharic: ኢማዴ የተባለ የ23 ዓመት ሞሮኳዊ ስደተኛ ባለፉት ስድስት ዓመታት በስፔን ውስጥ በኩሽና ረዳትነት በመስራት ራሱን ችሎ ለመኖር ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ገና በ16 ዓመቱ ቤተሰቡን ላለመጫን ከቤት የሄደው ይህ ወጣት፣ ከስድስት ዓመት መለያየት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ትውልድ ሀገሩ በመመለስ ቤተሰቡን ለመገናኘት እየተዘጋጀ ነው።
oromo: Imade dargaggeessi umuriin isaa waggaa 23 ta'e fi biyya Morookoo irraa godaane, waggoota ja'an darban kana Ispeen keessatti hojii gargaaraa kushiinaa hojjechaa jira. Umurii waggaa 16tti maatii isaa irratti ba'aa ta'uu dhiisuuf mana gadhiisee kan ba'e dargaggeessi kun, waggoota ja'a booda yeroo jalqatiif gara biyya isaatti deebi'ee maatii isaa argachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Diego Maradona bloated, bedridden and resigned before death, says masseur
english: In the ongoing trial regarding Diego Maradona’s 2020 death, his former masseur testified that the football star was bedridden, swollen from fluid retention, and seemingly defeated in his final days. The witness claimed he alerted medical staff to Maradona's worsening condition, but his concerns were dismissed by professionals who insisted the symptoms would resolve. Seven healthcare workers are currently facing trial for potential negligence, though they maintain their innocence regarding the legend's fatal heart failure.
amharic: የዲዬጎ ማራዶና የ2020 ህልፈተ ህይወት ጉዳይ እየታየ በሚገኝበት ችሎት፣ የቀድሞ የፊዚዮቴራፒ ባለሙያው የክፍለ ዘመኑ ኮከብ ከመሞታቸው በፊት በአልጋ ላይ እንደነበሩና በሰውነት እብጠት ሲሰቃዩ እንደነበር መስክረዋል። ምስክሩ የማራዶናን የጤና ሁኔታ ለህክምና ቡድኑ መግለጻቸውን ቢናገሩም፣ ባለሙያዎቹ ግን ምልክቶቹ ጊዜያዊ እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ ችላ ማለታቸውን አስረድተዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሰባት የጤና ባለሙያዎች በቸልተኝነት ወንጀል ክስ ቢመሰረትባቸውም፣ የፈጸሙት ጥፋት እንደሌለ በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Du'a Diego Maradona bara 2020 ilaalchisee mana murtiitti dhaddachi geggeeffamaa jiru irratti, nama isa harkaajaa turetu akkaataa jireenya isa guyyoota dhumaa ibseera. Maaraadoonaan siree irra ooluu, qaamni isaa dhiitachuu fi abdii kutatee akka ture ragaan kun ibseera. Isaan kunis yaalii fayyaa isaaf kennamuuf ture irratti hanqinni akka ture hojjettoota fayyaa akeekkachiisuu isaanii dubbataniiru, ta'us ogeeyyoonni fayyaa kun yaaddoo isaanii fudhachuu didaniiru. Yeroo ammaa kana ogeeyyoonni fayyaa torba yakka tuffii fi ittigaafatamummaa ba'achuu dhabuu irratti himatamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, isaan garuu himannaa dhiyaate kana waakkatu.

title: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan sign joint defence agreement: What’s in it?
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have officially signed the Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement to strengthen their regional security cooperation. This new pact establishes a collective defense system where an attack on one member nation is viewed as an aggression against all three. The alliance aims to promote stability and security amid rising tensions in the Middle East.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን የክልላቸውን የጸጥታ ትብብር ለማጠናከር የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነትን ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ አዲስ ስምምነት በአንድ አባል ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ የሚቆጠርበትን የጋራ መከላከያ ሥርዓት ይዘረጋል። ህብረቱ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት ለመቆጣጠር እና ሰላምን ለማስፈን ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Turkiin, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan tumsa nageenyaa naannichaa cimsuuf waliigaltee ittisa waliinii kan Makkaa mallatteessaniiru. Waliigalteen haaraan kun biyyoota sadan keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, akka haleellaa sadan irratti raawwatameetti kan ilaalamu ta'a. Waliigalteen kun naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti sochiilee jiran qabbaneessuufi nageenya mirkaneessuuf kan gumaachuudha.

title: UAE oil company says attacks are significantly impacting its operations
english: The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company reports that ongoing drone and missile strikes have severely disrupted its shipping activities near the Strait of Hormuz. Since the conflict with Iran began, 15 of its vessels have been targeted, resulting in one death and multiple injuries among the crew. The company is currently working to ensure the safety of its staff and assets while striving to maintain normal operations for its clients.
amharic: የአቡ ዳቢ ብሔራዊ የነዳጅ ኩባንያ በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አካባቢ እየደረሱ ያሉት የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች የስራ እንቅስቃሴውን በእጅጉ እንደጎዳው አስታውቋል። ከኢራን ጋር ከተፈጠረው ግጭት ወዲህ 15 መርከቦቹ ጥቃት የተሰነዘረባቸው ሲሆን በዚህም የአንድ ሰራተኛ ህይወት አልፏል፤ ሌሎች 20 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ኩባንያው የሰራተኞቹን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና የደንበኞቹን ፍላጎት ለማሟላት ጥረት እያደረገ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni boba’aa biyyoolessaa Abu Daabii, weerarri doonii fi misaa’elaa daandii galaana Hormuzitti gaggeeffamaa jiru hojiisaanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jiraachuu beeksiseera. Waraana Iran waliin erga eegalee, dooniwwan isaanii 15 kanneen ta’an miidhamaniiru; kunis lubbuu nam tokkoo kan galaafate yoo ta’u, hojjettoota 20 irratti miidhaan qaamaa ga’eera. Dhaabbatichi hojjettoota isaa eeguufi tajaajila abbootii qabeenyaa isaanii itti fufsiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: Video: Houthi strikes on Saudi-backed troops
english: Houthi forces recently launched attacks that resulted in the deaths of over 60 Saudi-supported government soldiers in Yemen. These incidents occurred between Thursday and Friday, representing the highest single death toll since the 2022 ceasefire began. This sudden surge in violence threatens the fragile stability that has persisted throughout the ongoing civil war.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን በሚገኙ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ደጋፊ የሆኑ የመንግስት ወታደሮች ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ከ60 በላይ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ይህ ክስተት ከሐሙስ እስከ ዓርብ የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ ከ2022 የእርቅ ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛው የሰው ህይወት ያለፈበት ጥቃት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል። ይህ ድንገተኛ ጥቃት ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ስስ ሰላም አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin waraana mootummaa Yaman kan Saudii Arabia deeggarsa argatu irratti haleellaa geggeesseen loltoonni 60 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan kun guyyaa Kamisaa fi Jimaataa gidduutti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, waldhabdee waggaa 2022 erga tasgabbaa'ee as lubbuu namaa baay'ee galaafate dha. Gochi kun nageenya biyyattii keessa tures rakkoo hamaa keessa galchuun sodaachisaa jira.

title: Russia drops record number of glide bombs on Ukraine as casualties pile up
english: In July, Russia launched a record 8,300 glide bombs against Ukraine as its own battlefield casualties climbed to an estimated 42,800 for the month. Despite these intense strikes, Russia's territorial gains have slowed significantly compared to previous years, largely due to Ukraine's increased use of drones. President Zelenskyy anticipates that these mounting losses may soon force Russia to mobilize hundreds of thousands of additional reservists.
amharic: በሐምሌ ወር ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ ሪከርድ የሆነ 8,300 የሚደርሱ የሚንሸራተቱ ቦንቦችን (glide bombs) የጣለች ሲሆን፣ በዚሁ ወር የራሷ የጦር ሜዳ ጉዳትም ወደ 42,800 ከፍ ብሏል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ ቢሆኑም፣ ዩክሬን ድሮኖችን በስፋት መጠቀም በመጀመሯ የሩሲያ የግዛት መስፋፋት ከቀድሞዎቹ ዓመታት ጋር ሲነጻጸር በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ እየጨመረ የመጣው ይህ ኪሳራ ሩሲያ በቅርቡ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን እንድታንቀሳቅስ ሊያስገድዳት እንደሚችል ያምናሉ።
oromo: Ji'a Adoolessa keessa, Raashiyaan boombiiwwan gosa 'glide' jedhaman 8,300 ol gara Yuukreenitti gadhiisuun rikoordii haaraa galteetti, ta'us duulli ishee kun miidhaa lubbuu 42,800 ga'uuf sababa ta'eera. Giddu galeessaan weerarri kun jabaataa dhufu illee, Yuukreen dooniiwwan (drones) guddiftee fayyadamuun ishee, Raashiyaan lafa qabachuu ishee akka hir'atu taasiseera. Prezidaant Zeelenskiin miidhaan kun itti fufuun isaa, Raashiyaan gara fuulduraatti loltoota dabalataa dhibba kumaan lakkaa'aman gara waraanaatti akka ergitu dirqisiisuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Armenian Apostolic Church leader faces trial as feud with PM deepens
english: The head of the Armenian Apostolic Church, Catholicos Karekin II, and six other clergy members are set to face trial for allegedly refusing to reinstate a defrocked bishop who supports Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. This legal action highlights a deepening political conflict between the Armenian government and the Church, following criticism over the Prime Minister's handling of the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict. Critics and human rights advocates argue that these charges are politically motivated and represent an improper state interference in religious affairs.
amharic: የአርሜኒያ አፖስቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን መሪ ካቶሊኮስ ካሬኪን ዳግማዊ እና ሌሎች ስድስት የቤተክርስቲያኑ አባላት፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኒኮል ፓሺንያንን የሚደግፍ የቀድሞ ጳጳስን መልሰው አልሾሙም በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ይህ የፍርድ ሂደት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የናጎርኖ-ካራባክ ግጭትን በአግባቡ አልያዙም በሚል ከቤተክርስቲያኑ ጋር ያላቸውን ውጥረት ያባባሰው ይመስላል። ተቺዎች እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ክስ የፖለቲካ ተነሳሽነት ያለው እና በመንግስት በኩል በቤተክርስቲያኑ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ላይ የተደረገ ጣልቃ ገብነት ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Waldaa Kiristaanaa Armeeniyaa Kaatolikos Karekiin II fi qeesonni biroo ja’a, namicha bishopii ta’ee turee fi Muummee Ministiraa Nikool Paashiniyaaniin deggeru gara hojiitti deebisuu diddaniiru jedhamee himatamuun gara mana murtiitti dhiyaataniiru. Himannaan kun waldhabdee siyaasaa Muummee Ministiraa fi Waldaa Kiristaanaa gidduu jiru kan dhoose yoo ta’u, kunis mata duree waraana Nagorno-Karabakh irratti wal-hubannoo dhabuu irraa kan madde dha. Namoonni himannaa kana morman akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun siyaasaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate fi dhimma amantii keessa seenuu mootummaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan sign joint defence pact
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have officially entered into a collective defense agreement during a meeting in Mecca. This pact establishes that an act of military aggression against one member will be treated as an assault on all three nations. The deal serves to strengthen security cooperation and mutual support among the three countries.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ ከተማ በተካሄደ ስብሰባ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራረሙ። ስምምነቱ በአንዱ አባል ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ማንኛውም ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በሦስቱም ሀገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ጥቃት እንደሚቆጠር ይደነግጋል። ይህ ስምምነት በሦስቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የጸጥታ ትብብር እና የጋራ መረዳዳት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan magaala Makkaa keessatti waliigaltee ittisaa gamtaa mallatteessaniiru. Waliigaltichi biyyoota sadan kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan waraanaa gaggeeffame, akka haleellaa sadan irrattuu raawwatameetti akka ilaalamu ibsa. Waliigalteen kun hariiroo nageenyaafi gargaarsa waliinii biyyoota sadan gidduu jiru kan cimsuudha.

title: UN chief condemns both Ukraine and Russia amid escalation in war
english: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has formally criticized both Russia and Ukraine for the recent rise in violence. He is urging both nations to lower tensions immediately and work toward a lasting peace agreement. This call follows a period of heightened combat, including Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian infrastructure.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ፀሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴያቸውን እንዲቀንሱ እና ዘላቂ የሆነ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ እንዲደርሱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ የሰላም ጥሪ የመጣው ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ መጋዘኖች ላይ ድሮን ጥቃት ማድረሷን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guuteereez, walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Yukreen gidduutti dabalaa dhufe kun akka dhaabbatu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaanuu tarkaanfii waraanaa isaanii gadi xiqeessee gara nagaa waaraatti akka dhufan gaafataniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe erga Yukreen buufataalee Raashiyaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa xiyyaara maleeydaa raawwattee booda dha.

title: Iran’s grip on trade is a potent weapon, but it has an expiry date
english: Iran is leveraging its control over the Strait of Hormuz to significantly disrupt international shipping, with traffic dropping by nearly 96 percent compared to last year. By restricting this critical global trade route, Tehran aims to use energy dependence as a form of coercive political power against the U.S. and Israel. However, experts warn that this strategy is unsustainable, as prolonged disruption will eventually diminish Iran's leverage and force the global economy to adapt.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያን በመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እያስተጓጎለች ትገኛለች። የባህር ትራፊኩ ባለፈው ዓመት ከነበረው ጋር ሲነጻጸር በ96 በመቶ ቀንሷል፤ ይህም ኢራን በኃይል ምንጮች ላይ ያለውን ጥገኝነት እንደ ፖለቲካዊ መሣሪያ እየተጠቀመችበት መሆኑን ያሳያል። ይሁን እንጂ የዚህ ስትራቴጂ የረጅም ጊዜ ውጤታማነት አጠራጣሪ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም የማያቋርጥ የንግድ መስተጓጎል በመጨረሻ የኢራንን ተጽዕኖ የመፍጠር አቅም በማዳከም ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ አማራጭ መፍትሄዎችን እንዲፈልግ ያስገድዳል።
oromo: Iiraan dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa uumuuf jedhee karaa balbala Hormuz cufuudhaan geejjiba idil-addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Traafikii dooniiwwanii waggaa darbee wajjin yoo madaallu dhibbeentaa 96 ol hir'ateera, kunis Iiraan dhiyeessii anniisaa akka meeshaa siyaasaatti itti fayyadamaa akka jirtu argisiisa. Haata'u malee, ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, tooftaan kun yeroo dheeraaf kan itti fufu miti; sababni isaas, addaan cituun daldalaa kun gara fuulduraatti humna dhiibbaa Iiraan qabdu hir'isuudhaan, biyyoonni addunyaa gara fuulduraatti furmaata biroo akka barbaadan kan dirqisiisu ta'a.

title: Iranian lawmaker criticises new "Mecca Joint Defence Agreement"
english: Iranian politician Ebrahim Rezaei has publicly criticized the new security alliance between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey. He argued that these types of agreements will not improve Saudi security, comparing them to their previous failed reliance on the United States. Instead, he advised Saudi leadership to reform their regional policies rather than seeking security guarantees from other nations.
amharic: የኢራኑ የፓርላማ አባል ኢብራሂም ረዛኢ በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በፓኪስታን እና በቱርክ መካከል የተደረገውን አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተችተዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ለሳውዲ አረቢያ አስተማማኝ ደህንነት እንደማያመጣ የገለጹት ረዛኢ፣ ሀገሪቱ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የነበራት ቀደምት የደህንነት ግንኙነት ውጤታማ እንዳልነበረ አስታውሰዋል። ይልቅስ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከሌሎች ደህንነትን ከመለመን ይልቅ የውጭ ፖሊሲዎቿን ማሻሻል እንዳለባት መክረዋል።
oromo: Miseensi paarlaamaa Iraan Ibraahim Reza'ii waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa Sa'udii Arabiyaa, Paakistaanii fi Tarkii gidduutti mallatteeffame qeeqaniiru. Waliigalteen kun nageenya Sa'udii fooyyessuuf hin gargaaru kan jedhan yoo ta'u, akkaataa itti dura Ameerikaa irraa nageenya barbaadanii turan waliin walitti qabanii ibsaniiru. Kanaa mannaa, Sa'udiin biyyoota biraa irraa nageenya kadhachuu dhiistee, imaammata ishee keessoo fi alaa irratti jijjiirama gochuu qabdi jechuun gorsaniiru.

title: Iranian official says deal with Oman on Hormuz finalised
english: An Iranian official announced that an agreement has been reached with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz. While the broad structure of this deal is set, officials are still finalizing the specific details and text. The final implementation of this understanding remains subject to approval by higher-ranking government authorities.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ቃል አቀባይ ከኦማን ጋር በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ዙሪያ ስምምነት ላይ መደረሱን አስታውቀዋል። የስምምነቱ አጠቃላይ ማዕቀፍ ቢወሰንም፣ ዝርዝር ጉዳዮቹ ገና እየተጠናቀቁ መሆኑ ተገልጿል። ሙሉ በሙሉ ተግባራዊ ከመደረጉ በፊት ግን ስምምነቱ በከፍተኛ የመንግስት አካላት ማረጋገጫ እንደሚያስፈልገው ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iiraan akka ibsanitti, dhimma harka galaana Hormuz irratti mootummaa Omaan waliin waliigaltee irra ga'ameera. Waliigaltee kanaaf gubbaan isaa kan qophaa'e yoo ta'u, qaamoleen lamaan guutuu isaanii irratti mari'ataa jiru. Waliigalteen kun hojiirra ooluuf sadarkaa olaanaatti raggaasifamuun akka isa barbaachisu ibsameera.

title: Right-sizing Tests Addis Abeba University’s Promise for Autonomy
english: Addis Ababa University's transition to autonomy has led to a major restructuring that left roughly 550 staff members without positions. While the university administration claims these employees were not fired and can choose retirement, compensation, or redeployment, many staff members worry their contracts will expire before new roles become available. The reform, intended to increase academic independence, has involved merging departments and implementing stricter qualification requirements for all personnel.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ወደ ራሱ በራስ የመተዳደር መብት መሸጋገሩን ተከትሎ በተደረገው መጠነ ሰፊ የአሰራር ማሻሻያ ወደ 550 የሚጠጉ ሰራተኞች ያለስራ መቅረታቸው ተገልጿል። የዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ሰራተኞቹ እንዳልተባረሩ እና የጡረታ አማራጭ፣ ካሳ ወይም በሌላ የስራ መደብ ላይ የመመደብ እድል እንዳላቸው ቢገልጽም፣ ብዙ ሰራተኞች ኮንትራታቸው ከማለቁ በፊት አዲስ የስራ እድል ያገኛሉ ወይ የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የትምህርት ተቋሙን ነጻነት ለማሳደግ ታቅዶ የተጀመረው ይህ ማሻሻያ መምሪያዎችን በማዋሃድ እና ለሰራተኞች ጥብቅ የብቃት መስፈርቶችን በመተግበር ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Finfinnee gara ofiin of bulchuutti ce'uuf godhe jijjiirama gurguddaa taasiseen hojjattoota 550 ol ta'an iddoo hojii dhabsiiseera. Bulchiinsi yuunivarsiitichaa hojjattoonni kunneen akka hin ari'amneefi filannoo soorama ba'uu, beenyaa fudhachuu ykn gara hojii biraatti jijjiiramuu akka qaban kan ibsu ta'us, hojjattoonni hedduun hojiin isaanii xumuramuun dura aangoo haaraa argachuun isaanii shakkii keessa galcheera. Jijjiiramni bilisummaa barnootaa dabaluuf karoorfame kun, dameewwan walitti makuufi ulaagaa beekumsaa cimaa hojjattoota irratti dirqisiisuun adeemsifamaa jira.

title: Tax Bills Outrun the Metre, Stalling Taxi-hailing Drivers
english: Ride-hailing drivers in Addis Ababa are struggling with significantly higher tax assessments that far exceed their original expectations. These rising costs, combined with expensive fuel and maintenance, are making it difficult for many to remain profitable. As a result, many drivers are abandoning ride-hailing platforms to operate manually and avoid these heavy tax burdens.
amharic: በአዲስ አበባ የሚገኙ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች ከጠበቁት በላይ በሆነ ከፍተኛ የታክስ ክፍያ ምክንያት ችግር ውስጥ ገብተዋል። እየጨመረ የመጣው የነዳጅ ዋጋ እና የተሽከርካሪ ጥገና ወጪ ከከፍተኛ ታክስ ጋር ተዳምሮ አሽከርካሪዎችን ለኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እየዳረጋቸው ነው። በዚህም ሳቢያ ብዙ አሽከርካሪዎች ከቴክኖሎጂ መተግበሪያዎች በመውጣት ታክስን ለመሸሽ በግል ሥራቸውን ለመቀጠል እየተገደዱ ነው።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni konkolaataa fe'umsaa (ride-hailing) Finfinnee keessa jiran, kaffaltii gibiraa isaanii dursee yaadamee ol ta'een rakkoo keessa galanii jiru. gatiin boba'aa fi kaffaltiin suphaa konkolaataa dabaluun isaa akkasumas gibirri hanga kanaa gahuun isaanii bu'aa hojii isaanii hir'iseera. Kanaan kan ka'e, ogeeyyonni baay'een isaanii appilikeeshinoota kanneen gadi dhiisanii, gibira irraa bilisa ta'uuf jecha karaa idilee (manual) fayyadamuuf dirqamaa jiru.

title: Shipping Lines Charts Biggest-Ever Fleet Plan After Buying None Planned for the Year
english: The Ethiopian Shipping & Logistics (ESL) enterprise has announced a major expansion plan to add 16 new vessels to its fleet by 2031, aiming to significantly increase its total cargo capacity. Despite these ambitious goals, the company failed to purchase any of the six ships it had originally scheduled for this year, with management citing procurement delays as the primary cause. This missed target has sparked concerns regarding the state company's ability to successfully execute such a large-scale project within the planned timeframe.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የባህር ትራንስፖርትና ሎጂስቲክስ አገልግሎት እስከ 2031 ድረስ መርከቦቹን በ16 አዳዲስ መርከቦች በማሳደግ የጭነት አቅሙን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመጨመር አዲስ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጓል። ኩባንያው በዚህ በጀት ዓመት ለመግዛት አቅዶ የነበረውን ስድስት መርከቦች ሳይገዛ በመቅረቱ የዕቅዱ አፈጻጸም ጥያቄ ውስጥ ወድቋል። አመራሩ መዘግየቱ የመጣው በግዥ ሂደቱ ውስብስብነት እንጂ በዕቅድ ለውጥ አለመሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ የተቋሙን የማስፈጸም አቅም በተመለከተ ስጋቶች ተፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan Geejjiba Galaanaa fi Logistiksii Itoophiyaa (ESL) hanga bara 2031tti dooniiwwan 16 haaraa bituun dandeettii fe'umsa isaa baay'isee guddisuuf karoora bal'aa baaseera. Ta'us, waggaa kana dooniiwwan ja'a bituuf karoorfate ture tokkollee bituu hin dandeenye; hogganoonnis sababa kana kan ta'e adeemsa bitannaa suuta deemuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Karoorri kun hanga kana bal'aa ta'e qabatamaa ta'uu isaa irratti shakkiiwwan uumamaniiru.

title: Ethiopian Eyes Bigger on Cargo as Costs Outrun Record Revenue
english: Ethiopian Airlines is expanding its cargo fleet with eight new Boeing and Airbus aircraft to increase its capacity and revenue despite facing significant financial challenges. Although the airline achieved record revenue, its expenses grew faster due to rising fuel costs, regional conflicts, and supply chain disruptions. Management remains optimistic that these modern, fuel-efficient planes will help the company maintain its competitive edge and long-term profitability.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ እያጋጠመው ያለውን ከፍተኛ የወጪ ንረት ለመቋቋም ስምንት አዳዲስ የካርጎ አውሮፕላኖችን በመረከብ የጭነት አገልግሎቱን እያሰፋ ነው። አየር መንገዱ ከፍተኛ ገቢ ቢያስመዘግብም፣ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር እና በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ወጪው ከገቢው በበለጠ ፍጥነት አድጓል። አዲሶቹ አውሮፕላኖች ነዳጅ ቆጣቢ በመሆናቸውና የጭነት አቅምን ስለሚጨምሩ አየር መንገዱ ተወዳዳሪነቱንና ትርፋማነቱን ለማስቀጠል ይጠቀምባቸዋል።
oromo: Bu'uuraalee Itoophiyaa baasii olka'aa ta'e dandamachuuf xiyyoorota fe'umsaa haaraa saddeet bituun tajaajila fe'umsaa isaa bal'ifachaa jira. Bu'uuraaleen kun galii seena-qabeessa galmeessisus, gatiin boba'aa dabaluu fi rakkooleen naannichaa baasiin akka gahu caalaa dabaluu isaa isaan mudatee jira. Xiyyoorotni haaraa kun baasii boba'aa hir'isuu fi dandeettii fe'umsaa dabaluun, dhaabbatichi dorgomaa ta'ee itti fufuuf akka isa gargaaran abdatameera.

title: Court Freezes Noah Flats as Buyers Open Second Front
english: The Federal High Court has blocked the sale or transfer of 27 apartments at Noah Victory Apartments for one month to allow a group of homebuyers to prepare a lawsuit against the developer. The buyers accuse Noah Real Estate of unfairly cancelling their contracts and demanding additional payments despite delays in completing the project. This court order prevents the company from selling these units to new customers while the legal battle over ownership and pricing continues.
amharic: የፌደራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የኖህ ቪክቶሪ አፓርታማዎችን የተመለከተ የቤት ገዥዎች ክስ ለማቅረብ እንዲችሉ የ27 አፓርታማዎችን ሽያጭ እና ዝውውር ለአንድ ወር አግዷል። የቤት ገዥዎቹ ኖህ ሪል እስቴት ውላቸውን ያለ አግባብ ሰርዟል እና በግንባታ መጓተት ምክንያት ተጨማሪ ክፍያ ጠይቋል በማለት ይከሳሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን እገዳ የጣለው ኩባንያው አፓርታማዎቹን ለሌሎች ከመሸጡ በፊት የባለቤትነት እና የዋጋ ክርክሩን በሕግ ለመፍታት እንዲቻል ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federalaa, gareen bittoota mana jireenyaa tokko mana isaanii irratti himata qopheeffachuu akka danda'aniif, mana jireenyaa 27 kan ta'an gurgurtaa fi jijjiirraa isaanii ji'a tokkoof dhorkeera. Bittoonni kun, dhaabbatichi 'Noah Real Estate' kontiraata isaanii haquu fi yeroo gabaa guutuu dadhabus kaffaltii dabalataa gaafachuu isaatti mormii qabu. Ajajni mana murtii kun dhaabbatichi manoota kana namoota biraatti osoo gurgurtaa hin raawwatin, dhimmi abbummaa fi gatii manichaa seeraan akka ilaalamuuf gargaara.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have formed a new defense alliance, agreeing that any aggression against one nation will be considered an attack on all three. This partnership aims to strengthen regional security in response to ongoing instability, including conflict involving Iran and Houthi rebels. By combining Saudi Arabia's financial resources, Turkey's military strength, and Pakistan's nuclear capabilities, the countries hope to deter regional threats.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ሀገራት ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ ይቆጠራል። አጋርነቱ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ስጋት ለመቋቋም ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ሀገራቱ ያላቸውን ወታደራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ አቅም በማቀናጀት የጋራ መከላከያ ለመፍጠር አቅደዋል።
oromo: Sa’udii Arabaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisaa haaraa mallatteessaniiru; kunis biyyoota sadan keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kan biyyoota sadanuu irratti akka raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta’a. Walii galteen kun rakkoolee nageenyaa naannichaa akkasumas walitti bu’iinsa Iran waliin walqabatu dhaabsisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Biyyoonni kun humna maallaqaa, humna waraanaa fi meeshaa niwukilaaraa walitti fiduun nageenya isaanii eeggachuuf walii galaniiru.

title: US strikes $1.2bn deal to pay German firm to halt offshore wind projects
english: The German energy firm RWE has reached a $1.2 billion agreement with the Trump administration to cancel its offshore wind projects in the United States. As part of this deal, the company will surrender its wind energy leases and redirect the funds toward conventional fossil fuel developments, specifically a liquefied natural gas terminal in Louisiana. This move aligns with the administration's broader policy to prioritize fossil fuels over offshore wind energy initiatives.
amharic: የጀርመኑ የኢነርጂ ኩባንያ RWE በአሜሪካ የነበረውን የባህር ላይ የንፋስ ኃይል ፕሮጀክቶቹን ለማቆም ከትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር በ1.2 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ስምምነት ላይ ደርሷል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሠረት ኩባንያው የንፋስ ኃይል መብቶቹን በመተው የተገኘውን ገንዘብ በሉዊዚያና በሚገነባ ፈሳሽ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ማቀነባበሪያ ፕሮጀክት ላይ ለማዋል ወስኗል። ይህ እርምጃ የንፋስ ኃይልን በመተው በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች ላይ ለመታመን የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከሚከተለው የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni anniisaa Jarmanii RWE, pirojektiiwwan anniisaa qilleensaa (offshore wind) Ameerikaa keessatti qabu dhaabuuf mootummaa Donald Trump waliin waliigaltee doolaara biiliyoona 1.2 irra ga'eera. Waliigaltee kanaan, dhaabbatichi lafa pirojektii kanaaf qabate gadi lakkisee, maallaqicha gara pirojektii gaazii uumamaa (LNG) Luyiziyaanaa keessatti ijaarutti akka jijjiiru beekameera. Tarkaanfiin kun imaammata mootummaa Ameerikaa kan anniisaa qilleensaa dhiisee gara anniisaa qulqulluu hin taane (fossil fuels) caalaatti deggaruu irraa kan madde dha.

title: First school for robots opens in China
english: China has inaugurated its inaugural educational facility dedicated to training humanoid robots. The primary objective of this school is to enhance the intelligence and capabilities of these machines. Once their training is complete, these robots will be deployed to begin working in various professional roles.
amharic: ቻይና ለሰብአዊ መልክ ያላቸው ሮቦቶች የመጀመሪያውን የትምህርት ተቋም ከፍታለች። የዚህ ትምህርት ቤት ዋና ግብ የሮቦቶቹን አስተሳሰብ እና ችሎታ ማዳበር ነው። ስልጠናቸውን ሲያጠናቅቁ እነዚህ ሮቦቶች በተለያዩ የስራ መስኮች ተሰማርተው አገልግሎት መስጠት ይጀምራሉ።
oromo: Chaayinaan manneen barnootaa warra namoota fakkaatan (humanoid robots) leenjisuuf gargaaru kan jalqabaa ta'e banatteetti. Kaayyoon mana barnoota kanaa ijoo guddina sammuu fi dandeettii rooboototaa fooyyessuudha. Erga leenjii isaanii xumuranii booda, roobootonni kunniin hojii garaa garaa keessatti bobba’anii tajaajila kennuu eegalu.

title: Cricket’s Shakib, an Hasina ally, will face trial in Bangladesh if secure
english: Bangladeshi cricket star Shakib Al Hasan, a former ally of ousted leader Sheikh Hasina, plans to return home from exile to face murder charges if his safety is guaranteed. The 39-year-old athlete, currently living abroad, hopes to participate in a farewell series and represent his country in the 2027 Cricket World Cup. His potential homecoming remains uncertain as he waits for legal and security clearance from the current government.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የክሪኬት ኮከብ እና የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሃሲና አጋር የነበረው ሻኪብ አል ሃሰን፣ ደህንነቱ ከተረጋገጠ በገጠመው የግድያ ክስ ለመከላከል ወደ አገሩ ለመመለስ ተዘጋጅቷል። በውጭ አገር በግዞት የሚገኘው የ39 ዓመቱ አትሌት፣ የስንብት ጨዋታዎችን ለማድረግ እና በ2027 የክሪኬት ዓለም ዋንጫ ላይ አገሩን ወክሎ ለመጫወት ይፈልጋል። ይሁን እንጂ ወደ አገሩ የሚመለስበት ሁኔታ አሁን ባለው መንግሥት የሕግ እና የደህንነት ማረጋገጫ ላይ የተመካ ነው።
oromo: Leenjisaan fi taphataan kriketii biyya Bangilaadish Shakib Al Hasan, michuu duraanii ministira muummee kan turan Sheikh Hasina, nageenyisaa mirkanaa'eef himata ajjeechaa isa irratti banameef mana murii dhiyaachuuf gara biyyaatti deebi'uuf qophiidha. Umriin isaa 39 kan ta'e fi biyya alaa jiraatu kun, tapha gaggeessaa gaggeessuu fi tapha waancaa addunyaa kriketii bara 2027 irratti biyya isaa bakka bu'uuf abdiidha. Haa ta'u malee, deebi'uun isaa mootummaa amma jiru biraa eeyyama seeraa fi nageenyaa argachuu isaa irratti kan hundaa'eedha.

title: Northern Ethiopia’s shifting alliances explained
english: The political landscape in northern Ethiopia has shifted significantly, with the federal government now accusing its former allies, the TPLF and Eritrea, of collaborating with Fano militias. While the government claims these groups are coordinating to destabilize the region and launch new attacks, TPLF leaders have dismissed these accusations as false propaganda. Meanwhile, the region remains volatile as Eritrean forces continue to hold border territories despite previous peace commitments.
amharic: በሰሜን ኢትዮጵያ ያለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ተቀይሮ የፌዴራል መንግስት የቀድሞ አጋሮቹ የሆኑትን የህወሓት ቡድን እና ኤርትራን ከፋኖ ታጣቂዎች ጋር በመተባበር እየሰሩ ነው ሲል ከሷል። መንግስት እነዚህ ቡድኖች ቀጠናውን ለማተራመስ እና አዲስ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እያሴሩ ነው ቢልም፣ የህወሓት አመራሮች ግን ክሱ መሰረት የሌለው እና የሀሰት ፕሮፓጋንዳ ነው ሲሉ አስተባብለዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ቀደም ሲል ከተደረገው የሰላም ስምምነት ውጪ የኤርትራ ወታደሮች አሁንም የድንበር አካባቢዎችን ይዘው በመቆየታቸው ውጥረቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Haalli siyaasaa kaaba Itoophiyaa keessaa jijjiiramuu irraa kan ka’e, mootummaan federalaa garee TPLF fi biyya Eritraaa duraan harka wal qabatanii turan, amma garee Fanoo wajjin hidhata uummatanii naannichaa jeequuf socho’aa jiru jedhee himate. Mootummaan garee kunneen walta’uudhaan lola haaraa qopheessaa jiru jedhee kan himatu ta’us, hogganoonni TPLF himannaa kana sobaafi oduu oofuu jedhanii mormaniiru. Kana gidduutti, waraanni Eritraa waliigaltee nageenyaa duraan ture darbee har’as daangaa Itoophiyaa keessaa bakkeewwan tokko tokko to’annoo isaa jala galchee waan jiruuf, naannichatti haalli nagaa tasgabbaa’uu hin dandeenye.

title: Exclusive: ICC judges order Taliban case split from Afghanistan probe that covers US troops
english: The International Criminal Court has directed prosecutors to launch a separate investigation into the Taliban regarding gender persecution, distancing this case from the wider probe into Afghanistan war crimes. This shift effectively decouples the Taliban investigation from inquiries involving US military and CIA personnel. Analysts suggest this move may be an attempt to reduce friction with Washington, following recent threats and sanctions imposed by the US against court officials.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት አቃብያነ ህግ በታሊባን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን የጾታ ጭቆና በተመለከተ የተለየ ምርመራ እንዲጀምሩ አዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ በታሊባን ላይ የሚደረገውን ምርመራ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ወታደራዊ እና የሲአይኤ ሰራተኞች ጋር ከተያያዘው የአፍጋኒስታን የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ለይቶታል። ይህ እርምጃ ፍርድ ቤቱ ከዋሽንግተን ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ የተወሰደ እንደሆነ እና አሜሪካ በፍትህ አካላቱ ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ ተከትሎ የመጣ እንደሆነ ታምኖበታል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) abbootii alangaa qorannoo dhimma ari’atamuu saalaatiin walqabatu kan garee Taalibaan irratti xiyyeeffatu adda baasanii akka geggeessan ajajeera. Tarkaanfiin kun qorannoo dhimma Taalibaan, qorannoo waraana Afgaanistaan kan miseensota waraana US fi CIA dabalatu irraa adda baasa. Qorannoon kun kan godhame, hidhata mana murtichaa fi Waashingitan gidduu jiru fooyyessuufi tarkaanfiiwwan adabbii US irra ga'aa turan tasgabbeessuuf akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Trump says war ‘can’t go much longer’ – what’s the latest on talks?
english: President Trump recently stated that he expects the conflict with Iran to conclude shortly, expressing optimism about ongoing negotiations. Meanwhile, Iran is considering legislation to restrict certain foreign vessels from the Strait of Hormuz, while simultaneously discussing shipping route coordinates with Oman. Experts warn that the U.S. may be facing significant military supply shortages, which adds pressure to reach a diplomatic resolution quickly.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ጦርነት በቅርቡ እንደሚያበቃ ተስፋ እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ የውጭ መርከቦችን እንቅስቃሴ ለመገደብ የሚያስችል ህግ እያጠናች ሲሆን፣ ከኦማን ጋርም ስለ መርከብ መስመሮች እየተወያየች ትገኛለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት የአሜሪካ የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦት እጥረት ስጋት በመኖሩ፣ ግጭቱን በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መፍታት አስፈላጊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp waraanni Iraan wajjin jiru yeroo dhiyootti akka xumuramu abdi qaban ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iraan dooniiwwan biyyoota alaa qaxxaamura galaana Hormuz irraa dhowwuuf seera baasuu yaadaa jirtu yoo ta'u, gama biraatiinis karaa doonii ilaalchisee Oomaan wajjin mari'achaa jirti. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa dhabuun ishee raadii ta'uun, waraana kana karaa nagaa fi diippilomaasiin xumuruun barbaachisaa ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Houthi attacks on gov’t forces hint that a major battle in Yemen is brewing
english: Houthi forces recently launched deadly drone and missile strikes against government military camps in Marib and Hadramout, resulting in significant casualties. This escalation marks the most serious increase in violence in years, raising concerns that the dormant civil war may be reigniting. Analysts believe this shift, fueled by broader regional tensions, indicates that Yemen is moving toward a major and widespread conflict.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በማሪብ እና በሃድራሞት በሚገኙ የመንግስት ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ በፈጸሙት የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት በርካታ ወታደሮች ተገድለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ለዓመታት ቆሞ የነበረውን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት እንደገና ሊያቀጣጥል የሚችል ከፍተኛ የጥቃት እርምጃ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ ጥቃት የየመን ግጭት ወደ ትልቅ እና አጠቃላይ ጦርነት እየተሸጋገረ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humnooni Huutii buufataalee waraana mootummaa Marib fi Hadraamoot keessa jiran irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (dronii) fi misayilaan gaggeessaniin lubbuun loltoota hedduu darbeera. Haleellaan kun waraanni waggoota dheeraaf qabbanaa'ee ture akka deebi'ee boba'u sodaachiseera. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, haleellaan kun rakkoolee naannichaa wajjin walqabatee, Yemen gara waraana bal'aa fi sodaachisaa ta'etti seenuuf akka jirtu agarsiisa.

title: Saudi ⁠Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye sign defence deal amid regional turmoil
english: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye have entered into a formal trilateral defense pact to strengthen security ties during a period of regional instability. This agreement establishes a collective security framework where an armed strike against one member is treated as an aggression against all three. The deal was finalized in Mecca by the leaders of these nations amid growing military tensions in the Middle East.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ቱርክ በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የፀጥታ ስጋት ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ በአንዱ አገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ እንደሚቆጠር ይደነግጋል። ስምምነቱ በሜካ የተፈረመ ሲሆን ይህም በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ወታደራዊ ውጥረት ለመግታት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Paakistaanii fi Turkiin naannichatti rakkoo nageenyaa dabalaa dhufe qolachuuf walii galtee ittisaa waliinii mallatteessaniiru. Walii galtee kanaan biyyoota sadan kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, akka haleellaa sadan irratti raawwatametti kan fudhatamu ta'a. Walii galteen kun magaalaa Makkaa keessatti hoogganoota biyyoota sadaniin kan mallatteeffame yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas waraana naannicha keessatti dabalaa jiru tasgabbeessuufi.

title: Why Trump is caught in an ‘escalation trap’ with Iran
english: Professor Robert Pape argues that former President Trump is facing a difficult dilemma regarding Iran, often described as an escalation trap. He suggests that Trump must choose between allowing Iran to gain more influence or further intensifying the conflict. This pressure is further complicated by political motives, as a symbolic victory against Iran might be viewed as beneficial for upcoming elections.
amharic: ፕሮፌሰር ሮበርት ፔፕ እንደገለጹት የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ትራምፕ ኢራንን በለቀቁ ቁጥር ተጽዕኖዋ እየጨመረ የመሄድ እድል ስላለው፣ በቀጥታ ግጭት ውስጥ ከመግባት ወይም ስልታዊ የሆነ ድል ከመፈለግ መካከል አንዱን መምረጥ አለባቸው። ይህ ውጥረት ትራምፕ በምርጫ ወቅት የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ትርፍ ለማግኘት ባላቸው ፍላጎት ምክንያት እየከፋ መጥቷል።
oromo: Pirofeesar Roobart Peep akka jedhanitti, duraan pirezidaantii kan turan Traamp dhimma Iraan irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa galanii jiru. title: Houthi strikes in Yemen as Saudi Arabia braces for attacks: What we know
english: Tensions in Yemen have escalated significantly as Houthi forces launched a series of lethal missile and drone strikes against government military positions, resulting in at least 30 soldier deaths. Simultaneously, attacks on southern Saudi Arabia have injured civilians, prompting fears of further regional instability. Intelligence reports suggest that Iran-backed groups may be planning additional assaults on key infrastructure, including energy facilities and airports, amid the broader conflict between Iran and the US-Israel alliance.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን መንግሥት ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ በሰነዘሩት የሮኬትና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 30 ወታደሮች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ በየመን ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። በተመሳሳይ በደቡባዊ ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ሲቪሎችን የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል ጥምረት መካከል ካለው ግጭት ጋር ተያይዞ በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት አባብሶታል። መረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት የኢራን ድጋፍ ያላቸው ኃይሎች በኃይል ማመንጫዎችና በሌሎች መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶችን ለመፈጸም እየተዘጋጁ ሊሆን ይችላል።

title: Houthi missile and drone attacks kill dozens of Yemeni government troops
english: Houthi forces launched a series of drone and ballistic missile strikes against Yemeni government positions on Thursday, resulting in the deaths of at least 38 soldiers. This incident represents the most severe escalation of violence since the UN-brokered truce began in 2022. The Houthi group claimed these attacks were a response to military reinforcements in the region, signaling a potential rise in conflict.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን መንግስት ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ በድሮን እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎች ባደረሱት ጥቃት ቢያንስ 38 ወታደሮች ተገድለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት እ.ኤ.አ ከ2022 የተባበሩት መንግስታት ስምምነት ወዲህ የታየ እጅግ አደገኛ የሆነ የግጭት መባባስ ነው። ሁቲዎች ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት በሳውዲ የሚደገፍ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴን ለመቃወም እንደሆነ የገለፁ ሲሆን፥ በየመን ያለው ግጭት ወደ አዲስ ውጥረት እያመራ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Gooteewwan Huutii guyyaa Kamisaa buufataalee waraana mootummaa Yaman irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee fi misayiliin raawwatanin lubbuun waraana 38 ol darbeera. Haleellaan kun dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin bara 2022 erga waliigaltee tasgabbii irra ga’amee booda haleellaa hammaataa ta’e dha. Huutonni haleellaa kana kan raawwatan waraanni mootummaa fi tumsitoonni isaa miilaan socho'uu isaaniitiin wal qabatee akka ta'e ibsanii, kunis waldhabdeen Yaman keessa jiru daran hammaachuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Houthi missile and drone attacks kill dozens of Yemeni government troops
english: Houthi forces launched a deadly series of drone and missile strikes against Yemeni government military sites, resulting in 38 deaths and 29 injuries. This marks the most significant violent escalation since the 2022 truce ended, as regional tensions intensify. The Yemeni government has vowed to retaliate, while the Houthis claim the attacks were a response to recent military build-ups in the region.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን መንግስት ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ በፈጸሙት ድሮን እና ሚሳይል ጥቃት 38 ወታደሮች ሲገደሉ 29 ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት እ.ኤ.አ ከ2022 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ የታየው ትልቁ የኃይል እርምጃ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። የየመን መንግስት ለጥቃቱ ተመጣጣኝ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ሁቲዎች በበኩላቸው እርምጃውን የወሰዱት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ላለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ምላሽ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huthifi haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi konkolaataa gargaarsa malee (drone) fi misayilii buufataalee waraana mootummaa Yaman irratti raawwataniin namoonni 38 yoo du'an 29 immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun walii galtee waraana dhaabuu bara 2022 booda miidhaa hammaataa sadarkaa olaanaa geessise yoo ta'u, kunis waldhabdeen naannichaa caalaatti akka hammaatu agarsiisa. Mootummaan Yaman haaloo bahuuf kan kalee ta'e yoo ta'u, gamtaan Huthifi immoo haleellaa kana kan raawwatan sochiilee waraanaa naannichatti adeemsifamaa jiran dura dhaabbachuuf akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: War on Iran: Saudi Arabia warns of imminent attacks by Iraqi groups and Yemen's Houthis
english: Saudi Arabia has issued a warning regarding potential coordinated attacks on its territory by Iran-backed groups in Iraq and Yemen. According to intelligence reports, these factions are allegedly preparing to target energy infrastructure and transport hubs using drones and missiles. In response to these growing threats, Riyadh is strengthening its security posture and is reportedly planning a new defense agreement with Pakistan and Turkey.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በኢራቅ እና በየመን በሚንቀሳቀሱ በኢራን የሚደገፉ ቡድኖች በግዛቷ ላይ የተቀናጀ ጥቃት ሊሰነዘር እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቃለች። በደረሰው የስለላ መረጃ መሠረት፣ ቡድኖቹ ድሮኖችን እና ሚሳኤሎችን በመጠቀም የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶችን እና የትራንስፖርት ማዕከላትን ለማጥቃት እየተዘጋጁ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ለዚህ ስጋት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ደኅንነቷን በማጠናከር ላይ ስትሆን፣ ከፓኪስታን እና ከቱርክ ጋር አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም እየተዘጋጀች ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan gareewwan Iraan deggertu kanneen Iraaqiifi Yaman keessatti argaman biyyattii irratti haleellaa wal-qabatee ta'e geggeessuu danda'u jechuun akeekkachiiste. Rifannaa kana dura dhaabbachuuf, Saudii Arabiyaan humna ishee cimsaa jirtu yoo ta'u, biyyattii Paakistaaniifi Turkii waliin waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa mallatteessuuf akka jirtus gabaafameera.

title: Turkey, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia sign "Mecca Joint Defence Agreement"
english: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey have officially formed a new military partnership known as the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. This pact aims to strengthen security cooperation between the three nations during a time of increased regional tensions. Officials from Turkey emphasized that the arrangement is strictly for defensive purposes and does not target any specific country.

oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Paakistaanii fi Turkiin walii galtee waraanaa haaraa kan 'Makkah Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu mallatteessaniiru. title: Central Europe sees record temperatures as heatwave continues
english: Central Europe is currently battling an extreme heatwave that has caused record-breaking temperatures and significant disruptions to energy production and transportation. Nations like Slovakia, Austria, and Hungary are dealing with plummeting water levels in the Danube River, which is hampering nuclear power output and shipping logistics. Italy has issued high-level heat alerts for all major cities, while across the continent, authorities are reporting rising fatalities as experts warn that these intense conditions are becoming the new normal due to climate change.

title: Saudi Pro League’s England international Toney charged with assault
english: England striker Ivan Toney, who currently plays for the Saudi club Al-Ahli, has been officially charged with assault following an incident at a London nightclub last December. The 30-year-old footballer is accused of causing actual bodily harm during the event. He is scheduled to appear in court in Westminster on September 24 to address these charges.
